A1.justification: Both ten-page PDFs contain the same PromptMeta paper, with readable text, equations, and Tables 1–4. Inspection through the final reference page confirms that neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original PromptMeta benchmark results in Table 2, component ablations in Table 3, and hyperparameter experiments in Table 4.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark, ablation, and hyperparameter results in Tables 2–4.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.4 retain the same attentive neighbor aggregator, meta-semantic prompt pool, fusion prompt, losses, and adaptation procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate few-shot completion of unseen relations on Nell-One and Wiki-One. No datasets, tasks, domains, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains identical comparator participation: TransE, TransH, DistMult, ComplEx, KG-BERT, GMatching, MetaR-I, MetaR-P, FSRL, FAAN, GANA, and HiRe.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1–5.3 retain the same dataset splits, candidate sets, MRR and Hits metrics, shot settings, embedding dimensions, and training/model-selection procedures. The ablation and sensitivity protocols also match.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the same semantic-information, MSP-pool, fusion-prompt, and pool-tuning ablations. Table 4 retains identical sensitivity analyses of tuning weight, negative-sample count, and pool size.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or statistical significance tests. Tables 2–4 retain the same point-estimate reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and accompanying findings in Tables 1–4 match. For example, PromptMeta's 5-shot MRR remains 0.327 on Nell-One and 0.386 on Wiki-One; ablation and sensitivity results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 3's task definition and Equations (1)–(16) are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added, removed, or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: combining meta-semantics with relational information, improved few-shot adaptation and benchmark performance, and pretrained semantic entity embeddings.

C2.justification: Sections 5.4–5.6 retain identical explanations of performance gains, component importance, and hyperparameter trends. No applicability boundaries, failure conditions, or substantive limitations are added or revised.

D1.justification: Section 5.3 preserves the same initialization and semantic-embedding construction, hyperparameters, PyTorch implementation, and Tesla V100 hardware disclosure. Code, dataset, and embedding release statements remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list contain the same cited works and positioning relative to few-shot KGC and graph-prompting research.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v1, 8 May 2025 to v2, 10 September 2025. The displayed title, authors, manuscript wording, headings, and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Rendered pages retain the same two-column layout and placement of Tables 1–4, with matching captions, row/column structures, and highlighting. Neither version contains figures.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, numerical evidence, explanations, reproducibility disclosures, and document organization are unchanged. The updated arXiv version/date stamp does not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
